name: bp-uv-resource-booking
description: Local-first UniApp resource and service booking boilerplate based on HIA-uView.

scripts.check: node scripts/verify-input-pins.mjs && node scripts/verify-font-subsets.mjs && node scripts/build-runtime-font-styles.mjs --verify-only && node scripts/verify-telemetry-boundary.mjs source && node scripts/check-rop.mjs && node scripts/verify-runtime-i18n.mjs

scripts.build:h5:review-home-loading: uni build -p h5 --mode review-home-loading && node scripts/verify-telemetry-boundary.mjs h5 && node scripts/prepare-h5-pages-artifact.mjs && pnpm run verify:h5-pages
scripts.build:h5:review-home-failure: uni build -p h5 --mode review-home-failure && node scripts/verify-telemetry-boundary.mjs h5 && node scripts/prepare-h5-pages-artifact.mjs && pnpm run verify:h5-pages
scripts.build:h5:review-home-empty: uni build -p h5 --mode review-home-empty && node scripts/verify-telemetry-boundary.mjs h5 && node scripts/prepare-h5-pages-artifact.mjs && pnpm run verify:h5-pages
scripts.build:mp-weixin: uni build -p mp-weixin && node scripts/prepare-mp-devtools-project.mjs && node scripts/verify-mp-runtime-shell.mjs && node scripts/verify-telemetry-boundary.mjs mp-weixin

scripts.build:mp-weixin:review-home-empty: uni build -p mp-weixin --mode review-home-empty && node scripts/prepare-mp-devtools-project.mjs && node scripts/verify-mp-runtime-shell.mjs && node scripts/verify-telemetry-boundary.mjs mp-weixin
